messages:
mira: Heads-up — noticed repeated "slice-bounce" behavior in sa-east1 overnight. Fractional dedicated slices getting packed then preempted and some tenants hit egress/KV bursts during handoff causing neighbor p99 spikes. Anyone tracked this pattern before? :eyes:

dario: can you share the promQL and one tenant id?

mira: prom snippet + sample tenant: tenant-banyan
```
sum(rate(kv_outbound_bytes{region="sa-east1"}[1m])) by (tenant)
sum(rate(slice_rehome_events[10m])) by (slice)
```

ops-bot: Alert slice_rehome_surge started at 2025-03-12T03:12:11Z severity=warning count=7

hana: quick theory: aggressive bin-packing + bursty KV flushes during rehome cause transient NVMe+PCIe pressure which stalls GPUs briefly. The scheduler then preempts and rehomes again -> bounce loop. We need a holdback + graceful handoff to break the cycle.

mira: proposed mitigation: slice-holdback policy for rehomes on fractional dedicated pools: when a slice is being rehomed, pause new allocs to that host for 60s, throttle egress from rehoming tenants with a soft cap, and prefer warm-rehome to copy KV state incrementally.

dario: detection rule to trigger holdback: 
```
WHEN slice_rehome_rate(host) > 2/5m AND neighbour_p99_increase > 30% AND kv_outburst_detected FOR 2m
```

sylvie: implementation notes: 1) add a scheduler flag `holdback_window=60s` 2) eBPF nic-shape policy `rehome_shield v0.1` to soft-throttle outbound during migration 3) warm-rehome async KV clone. eBPF config: 
```
program: rehome_shield v0.1
flags: burst_sec=20, rate_mbps=60, fallback=keep-in-chill
metrics: tenant_rehome_throttle_count, slice_holdback_seconds
```

hana: ops playbook draft: 
- enable slice-holdback canary on 4% of fractional slices in sa-east1 for 48h
- when trigger fires: 1) set holdback on host, 2) kick async warm-rehome, 3) apply rehome_shield to migrating pods, 4) if neighbor p99 still > baseline after 90s, move affected neighbor tenants to same-region hosted fallback.

mira: cost check: sample tenant-banyan had 1.4M outbound bytes in 12m (~50k tokens) => ~$0.13 if rerouted to hosted for that window. But breaking bounce loop prevents many minutes of neighbor stall, save in GPU-minutes. We'll tag rerouted requests with billing:rehome_fallback=true so billing can see token shift.

dario: metrics to add: tenant_rehome_throttle_count, tenant_warm_clone_latency, rerouted_tokens_est. Also gate global rollout: require neighbor p99 drop >=25% in canary within 48h.

sylvie: I'll push scheduler flag + eBPF shim to staging tonight. ops-bot: schedule rehome_shield v0.1 to staging at 1819995000 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled rehome_shield v0.1 to staging at 1819995000

hana: who owns dashboarding and billing tags? mira: can you wire the dashboard and add the billing tag in the reroute path?

mira: yes. I'll add tenant_rehome_throttle_count and rerouted_tokens_est to the SLO dashboard and coordinate with billing. Canary starts after staging deploy + 24h validation. :thumbsup:
